newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: John Keells up on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: John Keells up on foreign buying.

text.p: John Keells Holdings Ltd rose 1.14 percent, or two rupees, to 177 on foreign buying of 200,000 shares in early Monday trading.
Movement in the share price of John Keells, which is a highly capitalised blue chip holding company, has a big impact on the index, brokers said.
They said foreign buyers believe the share is relatively cheap at current levels, because it rose to over 400 rupees when the market peaked in early 1994.
